analysis.summary: ASK Automotive Limited reported strong performance in Q1 FY27, achieving its 11th consecutive quarter of robust results with record revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management raised its full-year growth guidance to high-teens, driven by robust domestic demand, favorable macroeconomic indicators, and operational expansions. The company also updated on its solar power initiatives, international collaborations, and increased capital expenditure plans to support upcoming orders. ASK Automotive reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, achieving its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT with consolidated revenue growth of 52.1% year-on-year. Management highlighted that absolute EBITDA remained strong at Rs.

guidance.claim: The company revised its full-year growth guidance from mid-teens to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates an export increase of 20% for the year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of continuing to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

guidance.claim: For the alloy wheel business, the company expects revenue of around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27 and about Rs. 220 Cr in FY28.
guidance.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: The management expects the industry to benefit from reforms, higher purchasing power, and easier vehicle finance access.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we believe the industry will continue to benefit from these far-reaching reforms, improving consumer purchasing power, and easier access to vehicle finance.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian automobile sector witnessed healthy momentum in FY26 with overall vehicle production registering a robust year-on-year growth of 11.8%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian automobile sector witnessed healthy momentum in FY26 with overall vehicle production across all segments registering a robust year-on-year growth of 11.8%.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler industry closed FY26 with a strong production volume of 26.7 million units, up from 23.9 million units in FY25.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry closed FY26 with a strong production volume of 26.7 million units, up from 23.9 million units in FY25.

demand_outlook.claim: The independent aftermarket grew by 24.7% in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's full-year capex estimate was revised upwards to approximately Rs. 700 crore due to new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant is planned to be urgently set up in Bangalore/South on a war footing.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is ready and expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operationalized a 9.9 MWp solar power plant for captive consumption.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: For next year's growth of mid-teens, the company needs to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: With aluminum prices expected to remain benign, management anticipates an improvement in EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect. However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: The payback period for the captive solar plant investment is estimated at five to five and a half years.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, we have explained that we have estimated that we'll get our payback of the investment in 5 to 5.5 years.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stood at 12.0% in Q1 FY27.
Absolute EBITDA remained strong at Rs. 164 Cr. against Rs. 123 Cr. in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Absolute EBITDA remained strong at Rs. 164 Cr. against Rs.123 Cr. in Q1 FY26 .

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA of Rs. 140 Cr with 31.1% year-on-year growth in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 140 Cr with 31.1% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year FY26, the company achieved an EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in Q4 FY26 was 12.1% and was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels stand at about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and about Rs. 250 crore for the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Export revenue from Ford Motors is expected to be about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and go up to Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant increased from 60% to 65% in the previous quarter to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Bangalore plant, which was our 18th plant, is running at near optimum capacity utilization and happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization, because we see the visibility for the Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: Bangalore plant capacity utilization has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be used to fund capex, though external financing via term loans for machines will be utilized for cash flow management.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management remains confident that the debt-to-equity ratio will remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia caused undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, sharply raising aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports was at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year due to various trade disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to operationalize a new plant in Bangalore/South before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The AISIN JV is expected to see some profitability by the end of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are also expecting that by the end of this year quarter, we'll see some profitability there.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to sustain the current level of EBITDA margins and continue efforts to improve gradually in subsequent quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to sustain current level of EBITDA margins and continue our efforts to improve gradually in the subsequent quarters, depending upon the growth of the two-wheeler industry and geopolitical environment.

management_commitments.claim: The company will be spending about Rs. 400 Cr on capex in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
